title: 有馬記念の後に・からっぽ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan ekes out a victory in the Arima Kinen with every fiber of her being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals quickly begin discussing areas they need to improve in. They seem completely alien to Jordan, who's too exhausted to even think.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nothing anyone says makes sense. It's like they're from another planet, speaking another language. It terrifies her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's convinced that her win was pure luck, and that she'll only lose from here on, because she's a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not in the mood to think about what's next. My suggestion to aim for the Osaka Hai falls on deaf ears.
